global_layer.context: A single continuous take inside a small corner cafe on a rainy afternoon.
global_layer.description: A barista lowers a cup onto a saucer and speaks one line to the customer while the camera pushes in.

aesthetics.contrast: low to moderate with open shadow detail
aesthetics.color_scheme: warm amber interior against cool grey window light

audio_baseline.ambience: steady rain against glass, low espresso machine hum, occasional cup clatter

objects_static.description: a white ceramic cup resting on a matching saucer
objects_static.shape_and_color: rounded white cup holding a pale crema surface
objects_static.relative_size: small, about one third the width of the barista's hand
objects_static.position: on the wooden counter in the lower right third of frame

lighting_baseline.conditions: soft overcast daylight through a large window with warm pendant fill
lighting_baseline.direction: key from the window at camera left, warm fill from overhead pendants
lighting_baseline.source_consistency: window and pendant sources hold the same intensity and color for the full clip

environment_baseline.background_setting: a small cafe interior with a wooden counter, shelves of stacked cups, and a rain streaked window behind

alive_subjects_static.description: a barista working behind the counter
alive_subjects_static.position: behind the counter at frame center
alive_subjects_static.orientation: facing camera, angled slightly to frame right

visual_attributes.facial_features: round face, dark eyes, hair tied back in a low bun
visual_attributes.clothing: dark green apron over a white shirt with rolled sleeves
visual_attributes.appearance_details: a thin silver ring on the right hand

camera_cinematography.overall_camera_style: single continuous slow push-in on a stabilized head
camera_cinematography.default_depth_of_field: shallow, the barista sharp and the shelves softly separated

segment_basic_info.segment_description: The barista lowers the cup onto the saucer with both hands and releases it, and the camera begins a slow push-in.
segment_basic_info.active_background: rain runs down the window behind her in continuous vertical streaks

camera_delta.focus: held on the barista's hands and face
camera_delta.camera_position: chest height, one meter back from the counter edge
camera_delta.composition: medium shot, barista at center, cup in the lower right third

dynamic_state.state_change: the cup travels from her hands down onto the saucer and comes to rest level and full
dynamic_state.motion_detail: a short controlled descent that settles without a wobble, the crema surface swaying once and flattening

spatial_position.location: on the counter in the lower right third
behind the counter at frame center
spatial_position.relative_size: upper body fills the central third
spatial_position.orientation: facing camera, shoulders square to the counter

action.primary_action: setting the cup down and releasing it
action.body_configuration: both elbows tucked close, forearms lowering together, spine upright
action.motion_detail: fingers open away from the cup one at a time, hands withdraw to the counter edge and rest there
action.interaction: both hands hold the saucer rim, then leave it fully supported on the counter
action.facial_expression: eyes down on the cup, mouth relaxed

causal_events.effect_outcome: the cup stays level on the counter and a thin ribbon of steam rises straight from the surface
causal_events.physics: the saucer takes the full weight of the cup and the liquid surface returns to level

ambience_deltas.ambience: rain and machine hum hold steady under a soft ceramic contact at the moment of placement

special_audio_events.sound_description: a short soft ceramic tap as the cup meets the saucer
special_audio_events.visual_sync: matches the frame where the cup base settles

segment_basic_info.segment_description: The barista lifts her gaze to the customer, speaks one line, and holds a small closing smile as the push-in settles.
segment_basic_info.active_background: rain continues down the window at the same rate

camera_delta.focus: shifts from the cup to the barista's eyes and holds
camera_delta.camera_position: chest height, now half a meter from the counter edge
camera_delta.composition: medium close-up, barista at center, cup still visible in the lower right corner

camera_movement.direction: forward along the lens axis, decelerating to a stop
camera_movement.intensity: slowing to rest by the final second

dynamic_state.state_change: the cup remains at rest on the saucer, still full
dynamic_state.motion_detail: only the steam moves, drifting upward and thinning

spatial_position.location: on the counter in the lower right corner
behind the counter at frame center
spatial_position.relative_size: head and shoulders fill the central half

action.primary_action: looking up and speaking one line, then holding still
action.body_configuration: chin lifts, shoulders stay level, hands rest on the counter edge
action.motion_detail: gaze rises to camera, lips articulate the line, then the mouth closes into a small smile that holds
action.interaction: addresses the customer standing at the counter off camera
action.facial_expression: attentive, warming into a brief smile

dialogue_lines.speaker: <subject 1>
dialogue_lines.delivery: warm and low, unhurried, close to the microphone

ambience_deltas.ambience: the machine hum drops away and the rain remains alone under the final hold
